purpose: Lightweight external transfer evidence with frozen architectures and leakage-safe task adaptation for a JCIS materials application paper.
selection_origin: All model architectures, physical descriptors, PCA grouping and biomimetic gate structure were frozen from matbench_phonons before inspecting jdft2d or dielectric test performance. Only learning rate and epoch are calibrated inside each outer-training fold.

fixed_cgcnn_baseline.freeze_basis: CGCNN architecture frozen from the phonons development study; only optimization is calibrated within each outer-training fold.

fixed_materon_pca.role: grouped-PCA physical node representation without gate
fixed_materon_pca.freeze_basis: Grouped-PCA physical representation frozen from phonons; only optimization is calibrated within each outer-training fold.

fixed_materon_explain.role: full20 physical features plus frozen biomimetic excitation/inhibition gate
fixed_materon_explain.freeze_basis: Cross-fold consensus biomimetic gate architecture frozen from phonons; only optimization is calibrated within each outer-training fold.

optimization_calibration.inner_split: deterministic quantile-stratified holdout from outer-training data only
optimization_calibration.final_refit: reinitialize and train on the complete outer-training fold using selected learning rate and epoch
